hero.desc: We are a custom ironwork workshop in Miami. We specialize in custom design and artistic forging. We create unique pieces to the client's taste. We fabricate iron doors, balconies, railings, and privacy fences. We use premium materials like aluminum, stainless steel 304/316L, bronze, and wrought iron. Every chandelier or gate gets a flawless powder-coated finish.

about.desc2: Metal is a canvas for us. We forge doors, railings, and chandeliers from scratch. Dario personally oversees every detail in the workshop. We guarantee durable artistic forging using aluminum or stainless steel. Your custom ironwork will be a lasting legacy for your property.

faq.title: Technical Ironwork Answers
faq.desc: All key information structured about our materials, local regulations in Miami-Dade and delivery processes.

items.q: Does Dario's comply with the Florida Building Code (FBC) for hurricanes?
items.a: Yes, Darioscustom complies strictly with the Florida Building Code (FBC). Our iron doors, gates, and balconies resist hurricane winds up to 175 mph. We use precise engineering and custom design to secure your property. This safety level is essential for custom ironwork in Miami.

items.q: What are the differences between traditional blacksmith paint and Powder Coating?
items.a: Powder Coating is a protective finish baked at 400°F. It is heavily superior to traditional paint. This process protects your iron doors and balconies against the Miami sun and sea salt. It guarantees your custom design will not rust easily.

items.q: What service areas do you cover in South Florida?
items.a: Our service areas in South Florida cover all of Miami-Dade county. We install custom ironwork in Miami, Coral Gables, Doral, Brickell, Pinecrest, and Key Biscayne. We bring our custom design, privacy fences, and iron doors directly to your residence.

items.q: What kind of maintenance do your metal gates and grilles require?
items.a: The maintenance of our metal gates and railings is very simple. You only need to wash the structure every 3 to 6 months with mild soap and water. Our electrostatic finish protects your custom ironwork in Miami, keeping your iron doors looking brand new.

items.q: What is the process to request a technical quote for my residence or business?
items.a: The process to request a technical quote starts by contacting us via WhatsApp. Send us measurements and photos of your space. First, we provide a price estimate for your custom design. Then, we visit your Miami home to measure and forge your iron doors or chandeliers.
